mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS llmTotalCalls, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN call_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS llmSuccessCalls, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN call_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS llmFailCalls, COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens), 0) AS llmInputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens), 0) AS llmOutputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS llmTotalTokens, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(duration), 2), 0) AS llmAvgDurationMs FROM ai_llm_call_log

SELECT COUNT(*) AS retrievalTotalCalls, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN call_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS retrievalSuccessCalls, COALESCE(SUM(retrieved_count), 0) AS retrievalTotalChunks, COALESCE(SUM(query_embedding_tokens), 0) AS retrievalEmbeddingTokens, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(duration), 2), 0) AS retrievalAvgDurationMs FROM ai_knowledge_retrieval_log

SELECT COUNT(*) AS docTotalOps, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN call_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS docSuccessOps, COALESCE(SUM(chunk_count), 0) AS docTotalChunks, COALESCE(SUM(total_embedding_tokens), 0) AS docEmbeddingTokens FROM ai_knowledge_doc_log

SELECT time_sign AS date,
hour_sign AS hour, NULL AS hour,
COUNT(*) AS llmCalls, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS llmTotalTokens, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(duration), 2), 0) AS llmAvgDurationMs FROM ai_llm_call_log
GROUP BY time_sign, hour_sign ORDER BY time_sign, hour_sign GROUP BY time_sign ORDER BY time_sign

SELECT time_sign AS date,
hour_sign AS hour, NULL AS hour,
COUNT(*) AS retrievals, COALESCE(SUM(query_embedding_tokens), 0) AS retrievalEmbeddingTokens FROM ai_knowledge_retrieval_log
GROUP BY time_sign, hour_sign ORDER BY time_sign, hour_sign GROUP BY time_sign ORDER BY time_sign

SELECT time_sign AS date,
hour_sign AS hour, NULL AS hour,
COUNT(*) AS docOps FROM ai_knowledge_doc_log
GROUP BY time_sign, hour_sign ORDER BY time_sign, hour_sign GROUP BY time_sign ORDER BY time_sign

SELECT model_id AS modelId, MAX(model_name) AS modelName, MAX(model_provider) AS modelProvider, COUNT(*) AS totalCalls, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN call_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS successCalls, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN call_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failCalls, COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens), 0) AS totalInputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens), 0) AS totalOutputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(duration), 2), 0) AS avgDurationMs FROM ai_llm_call_log
GROUP BY model_id ORDER BY totalCalls DESC

SELECT knowledge_base_id AS knowledgeBaseId, MAX(knowledge_base_name) AS knowledgeBaseName, COUNT(*) AS totalRetrievals, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN call_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS successRetrievals, COALESCE(SUM(retrieved_count), 0) AS totalRetrievedChunks, COALESCE(SUM(query_embedding_tokens), 0) AS totalEmbeddingTokens, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(duration), 2), 0) AS avgDurationMs FROM ai_knowledge_retrieval_log
GROUP BY knowledge_base_id ORDER BY totalRetrievals DESC

SELECT operation_type AS operationType, COUNT(*) AS totalOps, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN call_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS successOps, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN call_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failOps, COALESCE(SUM(chunk_count), 0) AS totalChunks, COALESCE(SUM(total_char_count), 0) AS totalCharCount, COALESCE(SUM(total_embedding_tokens), 0) AS totalEmbeddingTokens FROM ai_knowledge_doc_log
GROUP BY operation_type ORDER BY totalOps DESC
